component.name: QtDMM
component.summary: Read out and record digital multimeters

description.p: QtDMM reads digital multimeters (DMMs) over serial and USB cables, Bluetooth LE or the network, shows the reading as an LCD display and an analog meter, and records it with a configurable transient recorder. It is especially useful for older multimeters whose original software no longer runs on current operating systems.

ul.li: More than 150 meters from UNI-T, Voltcraft, Metex, PeakTech, Fluke, Brymen and others, plus bench meters through sigrok-cli
Recorder with export as CSV, Excel, OpenDocument, SVG, PDF and PNG
Readings table, alarms, calculated values across several meters
SCPI server, so other programs can read the meter over the network

description.p: QtDMM runs on Linux, Windows, macOS and FreeBSD.

First release candidate for QtDMM 26.4: many meters on one bench, each with its own front panel, in one graph and one recording; more needle meters and Poincaré plots, a third graph axis, PASS/FAIL test, alarm sounds, the designs Light Metal and Dark Metal, and many new meters.

QtDMM 26.3: keys of your own, a hideable toolbar, alarm colours on the displays, time cursors, a reference line and an overview in the graph, meters with up to four values with a sidebar row for each, and a much larger SCPI server with channels and VXI-11. New Bluetooth meters from UNI-T, APPA, ZOTEK and HoldPeak, and a Flatpak with its own signed repository. Since the release candidate: fixes for the designs, Victron devices and the window dividers.

QtDMM 26.2: a new main window with display, analog meter, graph, readings table and the new Poincaré plot as windows in one area, the designs System, Silver and Dark, a sidebar with My devices and an assistant to add a meter, a tidied settings dialog, the graph modes Live, Record and View with a recording that keeps every reading, the SCPI server also over HiSLIP for VISA, keys for the UNI-T Bluetooth meters, USB-HID cables that are found again after plugging in, and about 60 more meters, among them Keysight U12xx, APPA, UNI-T thermometers and luxmeters. Since the release candidate: fixes for the graph and the digital display, and a Nix flake.

QtDMM 26.1, the first release since 0.9.8 (2017): Qt 6, Windows, macOS and FreeBSD builds, more than 150 meters over serial, USB, Bluetooth LE and the network, recorder export to spreadsheets and images, alarms, readings table and an SCPI server. Since the release candidates: MIN and MAX on the analog meter, readings without leading zeros, fixes for several meters and a disk image for macOS.

Second release candidate for QtDMM 26.1, with the fixes after rc1: command-line options in the AppImage, a settings dialog that fits small screens, the recorder time window, alarm messages, new instances that start with the current settings, a scalable app icon and packaging for Fedora.
